== Original Virtual Set 11 published English card text ==
The remaster limits the initial once-per-game stack to an Interrupt the opponent just played. It retrieves any starship, using the ordinary specific-card destination of the Used Pile. The Gold slip restricts retrieval to a Rebel starship and sends it to hand. Both have a Grabber icon, which moves from the box to the type strip.
